posts.title: Buoyancy
posts.description: Every few months a new AI model comes out, and each time, the same event has opposite effects on different products. Some get better the moment the model ships. Others get worse. The property that separates them needs a name. I call it buoyancy.

posts.title: Hybrid Anxiety and Hybrid Optimism: The Near Future of Work
posts.description: I wrote a guest essay for Future.com (a16z’s new media site) that goes deep into the challenges and shifts we might expect with hybrid work—especially the rise of multiplayer apps and the importance of presence.
